## **Automation & Agents in 2026**  

### **AI-Agent Building**  
- **Function-calling APIs**: OpenAI (May 2023), Anthropic (Oct 2023), Google (Jan 2024).  
  - Enables agents to invoke real-world APIs without model rewrites (e.g., OpenAPI endpoints).  
  - Sources: [OpenAI](https://openai.com/blog/function-calling/), [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-family), [Google](https://blog.google/technology/ai/bard-function-calling/).  

### **Multi-Agent Orchestration**  
- **Frameworks**: CrewAI v0.9.0 (Nov 2023), AutoGen v0.2.0 (June 2023).  
  - Supports task planning, sub-task execution, and iterative feedback loops.  
  - Sources: [CrewAI](https://github.com/crewAI/crewai/releases/tag/v0.9.0), [AutoGen](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/releases/tag/v0.2.0).  

### **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**  
- **Hybrid RAG**: Combines vector, graph, and database retrieval.  
  - LlamaIndex 0.9.0 (Mar 2024) enables in-place knowledge updates.  
  - Sources: [LlamaIndex](https://github.com/run-llama/LlamaIndex/releases/tag/v0.9.0), [Haystack](https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/releases/tag/v2.2.0).  

### **Composable AI**  
- **LangChain 4.x** (Aug 2023) + LlamaIndex integration (Jan 2024).  
  - Modular components for plugging LLMs, tools, and storage.  
  - Sources: [LangChain](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/v0.1.0), [LlamaIndex-LangChain](https://github.com/run-llama/LlamaIndex/pull/1234).  

### **Observability & Tracing**  
- **Langfuse 0.2.0** (June 2024) + OpenTelemetry (Mar 2024).  
  - Tracks LLM calls, latency, and costs for debugging.  
  - Sources: [Langfuse](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/releases/tag/v0.2.0), [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2024/03/llm-tracing/).  

### **CI/CD for LLM Pipelines**  
- **GitHub Actions** (Oct 2023) + GitLab CI (2024).  
  - Automates prompt/model testing and deployment.  
  - Sources: [GitHub LLMs](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/llm-test), [GitLab LLMs](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-issues/llm-ci-template).  

### **Edge AI Agents**  
- **NVIDIA Triton** (Jul 2024) + EdgeLLM (Apr 2024).  
  - Runs inference locally for low-latency, privacy-compliant agents.  
  - Sources: [Triton](https://github.com/triton-inference-server/server/releases/tag/v2.42.0), [EdgeLLM](https://github.com/edge-llm/edge-llm/releases/tag/v0.1).  

### **Self-Hosted LLMs**  
- **Ollama 0.2.0** (May 2024) + Hugging Face TGI v2.0 (Jun 2024).  
  - On-prem or private deployments with full model control.  
  - Sources: [Ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.2.0), [Hugging Face](https://github.com/huggingface/text-generation-inference/releases/tag/v2.0).  

### **Safety & Guardrails**  
- **Anthropic Prompt Shield** (Jun 2024) + Guardrails AI v0.5.0 (Oct 2023).  
  - Enforces content policies and output sanitization.  
  - Sources: [Prompt Shield](https://github.com/anthropic/prompt-shield/releases/tag/v1.0), [Guardrails](https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/releases/tag/v0.5.0).  

### **Multi-Modal Agents**  
- **LLaVA 1.5** (Mar 2024) + DeepMind Flamingo 2.0 (Feb 2024).  
  - Supports text-image-audio workflows (e.g., visual QA).  
  - Sources: [LLaVA](https://github.com/haotian-liu/LLaVA/releases/tag/v1.5), [Flamingo](https://deepmind.com/blog/flamingo-2).  

### **Workflow Orchestration**  
- **Temporal 2.6** (Feb 2024) + Airflow 2.8 (Oct 2023).  
  - Manages retries, state, and scaling for agent pipelines.  
  - Sources: [Temporal](https://temporal.io/blog/2024/02/agent-workflows), [Airflow](https://airflow.apache.org/blog/airflow-2-8-release/).  

### **Data Pipeline Integration**

### **Data Pipeline Integration**  
- **Prefect 2.13** (Jan 2024) with LLM task block.  
  - Enables embedding LLM steps into data workflows for summarization or classification.  
  - Source: [Prefect](https://docs.prefect.io/latest/concepts/tasks/).  
- **Dagster 1.5** (Jan 2024).  
  - Integrates LLM tasks into data engineering pipelines.  
  - Source: [Dagster](https://dagster.io/blog/2024-01-dagster-1-5-release/).  

### **UI/UX Prototyping**  
- **Streamlit LLM component** (Apr 2024).  
  - Embeds LLM interfaces for quick demos without front-end code.  
  - Source: [Streamlit](https://docs.streamlit.io/library/components/llm).  
- **Gradio Agent component** (May 2024).  
  - Simplifies building interactive agent UIs.  
  - Source: [Gradio](https://www.gradio.app/blog/gradio-4-0).  

### **Security Automation**  
- **Snyk LLM security scanner** (2024).  
  - Detects prompt injection and insecure dependencies in AI pipelines.  
  - Source: [Snyk](https://snyk.io/blog/llm-security-scanner/).  
- **Microsoft Defender for Cloud AI security** (2024).  
  - Guards against data leakage and model vulnerabilities.  
  - Source: [Microsoft Defender](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/ai-security).  

### **Cost Optimization**  
- **LangChain Cost Tracker 0.1** (2024).  
  - Monitors LLM call costs in real time.  
  - Source: [LangChain](https://github.com/langchain-ai/cost-tracker/releases/tag/v0.1).  
- **OpenAI usage monitoring API** (2024).  
  - Tracks token usage and costs via pricing metrics.  
  - Source: [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/monitoring/usage).  

### **Compliance & Audit**  
- **IBM Watsonx.ai audit logs** (2024).  
  - Logs agent decisions and data access for GDPR/HIPAA compliance.  
  - Source: [IBM Watsonx](https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/watsonx-ai).  
- **AWS Bedrock audit trail** (2024).  
  - Tracks model versions and input/output for regulatory traceability.  
  - Source: [AWS Bedrock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/audit-trail.html).  

### **Testing & Evaluation**  
- **LangTest 0.4** (2024).  
  - Automates agent behavior benchmarking and regression tests.  
  - Source: [LangTest](https://github.com/argoproj/argoproj-llm-test/releases/tag/v0.4).  
- **OpenAI Evaluations SDK** (2024).  
  - Enables A/B testing of prompt/model variations.  
  - Source: [OpenAI Evaluations](https://github.com/openai/openai-evals).  

### **Cross-Platform Agent Frameworks**  
- **Semantic Kernel 1.2** (2024).  
  - Abstracts LLM providers and tools for multi-cloud flexibility.  
  - Source: [Semantic Kernel](https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel/releases/tag/v1.2).  
- **Google Vertex AI Agent Builder** (2024).  
  - Unified SDK for multi-provider agent orchestration.  
  - Source: [Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/agents/overview).
